completionWorkOrder: Confirm current subject-grade source and prescriptive status, including integrated/stage placements and actual programme/medium variants.
Read relevant current material clauses and independently verify edition/boundary before a comprehensive subject-grade claim.
Reconcile older reference positions without assuming retained, changed or superseded status from index presence alone.
Resolve applicable language/art/resource/performance bindings, and keep alternative/contextual requirements honest.
Align whole requirements with existing claims first; introduce new claims only after a documented failed reuse search.
